verses.sloka: तथा वसिष्टे ब्रुवति राजा दशरथः स्वयम् ।प्रहृष्ट वदनो रामम् आजुहाव स लक्ष्मणम् ॥१-२२-१॥
verses.transliteration: tathā vasiṣṭe bruvati rājā daśarathaḥ svayam ।prahṛṣṭa vadano rāmam ājuhāva sa lakṣmaṇam ॥1-22-1॥

translations.english: Vasishta having said thus, king Dasaratha, with cheerful countenance summoned Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: कृतः स्वस्त्ययनम् मात्रा पित्रा दशरथेन च ।पुरोधसा वसिष्ठेन मङ्गलैः अभिमंत्रितम् ॥१-२२-२॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtaḥ svastyayanam mātrā pitrā daśarathena ca ।purodhasā vasiṣṭhena maṅgalaiḥ abhimaṁtritam ॥1-22-2॥

translations.english: Rama was given farewell by his parents with recitation of mantras (for securing prosperity and averting evils). Priest Vasishta sanctified him with mantras Dasaratha kissed his son on the forehead and delivered him to the care of Viswamitra, with a heart full of cheer.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! आप महाराज रघु के वंश में उत्पन्न होकर, बात कह कर सुकरते हे । यह तो आपकी वंशपरम्परा से उल्टी बात है और ठीक भी नहीं है

verses.sloka: स पुत्रम् मूर्ध्नि उपाघ्राय राजा दशरथः तदा ।ददौ कुशिक पुत्राय सुप्रीतेन अंतरात्मना ॥१-२२-३॥
verses.transliteration: sa putram mūrdhni upāghrāya rājā daśarathaḥ tadā ।dadau kuśika putrāya suprītena aṁtarātmanā ॥1-22-3॥

translations.english: Rama was given farewell by his parents with recitation of mantras (for securing prosperity and averting evils). Priest Vasishta sanctified him with mantras Dasaratha kissed his son on the forehead and delivered him to the care of Viswamitra, with a heart full of cheer.
translations.hindi: अच्छा, यदि आपकी यही इच्छा है तो, लो में यह चला | आप अपनी प्रतिज्ञा मेट कर भाई-बन्धुओं सहित प्रसन्न रहिये

verses.sloka: ततो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो नीरजस्को ववौ तदा ।विश्वामित्र गतम् रामम् दृष्ट्वा राजीव लोचनम् ॥१-२२-४॥
verses.transliteration: tato vāyuḥ sukha sparśo nīrajasko vavau tadā ।viśvāmitra gatam rāmam dṛṣṭvā rājīva locanam ॥1-22-4॥

translations.english: At the sight of the lotuseyed Rama accompanying Viswamitra, the wind blew pollenfree with a gentle touch.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार बुद्धिमान्‌ विश्वामित्र के कुपित होने पर, समस्त पृथ्वी हिल उठी ओर देवता लोग डर गये

verses.sloka: पुष्प वृष्टिः महती आसीत् देव दुन्दुभि निःस्वनैः ।शङ्ख दुन्दुभि निर्घोषः प्रयाते तु महात्मनि ॥१-२२-५॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahatī āsīt deva dundubhi niḥsvanaiḥ ।śaṅkha dundubhi nirghoṣaḥ prayāte tu mahātmani ॥1-22-5॥

translations.english: The departure of glorious Viswamitra was greeted with incessant showers of flowers, the beating of celestial drums and the blowing of conches.
translations.hindi: तव सारे संसार को त्रस्त देख, श्रेष्ठव्रतपरायण एवं घैयेवान्‌ महर्षि वसिष्ठ जी, महाराज दशरथ से बोले

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रो ययौ अग्रे ततो रामो महायशाः ।काक पक्ष धरो धन्वी तम् च सौमित्रिः अन्वगात् ॥१-२२-६॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro yayau agre tato rāmo mahāyaśāḥ ।kāka pakṣa dharo dhanvī tam ca saumitriḥ anvagāt ॥1-22-6॥

translations.english: Viswamitra walked in the forefront. Behind him was Rama, bow in hand, while in the archer, Sumitra's son (Lakshmana) with side locks of hair followed.
translations.hindi: आप महाराज इद्धाक के कुल में उत्पन्न मानों साक्षात्‌ धर्म की दूसरी मूर्ति हैं। आप श्रीमान्‌, बृतिवान्‌ और सुत्रतधारी हो करु धम का त्याग न कर

verses.sloka: कलापिनौ धनुष् पाणी शोभयानौ दिशो दश ।विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् त्रि शीर्षौ इव पन्नगौ ।अनुजग्मतुः अक्षुद्रौ पितामहम् इव अश्विनौ ॥१-२२-७॥
verses.transliteration: kalāpinau dhanuṣ pāṇī śobhayānau diśo daśa ।viśvāmitram mahātmānam tri śīrṣau iva pannagau ।anujagmatuḥ akṣudrau pitāmaham iva aśvinau ॥1-22-7॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana equipped with bows and quivers resembled three hooded serpents. Warriors of no less prowess, they illuminated the ten quarters and followed the high souled Viswamitra like twin Aswanikumaras following the grandsire, Brahma.
translations.hindi: तीनों लोकों में आप धर्मात्मा कह कर प्रसिद्ध हैं । अतएव आप अपने धर्म की रक्षा कीजिए, अधमे न कीजिए

verses.sloka: तदा कुशिक पुत्रम् तु धनुष् पाणी स्वलंकृतौ ।बद्ध गोध अंगुलि त्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती ॥१-२२-८॥
verses.transliteration: tadā kuśika putram tu dhanuṣ pāṇī svalaṁkṛtau ।baddha godha aṁguli trāṇau khaḍgavantau mahādyutī ॥1-22-8॥

translations.english: Then bows in hand, wellattired, their fingers encased in mongrel skin, for protection (against the bowstring) armed with scimitars, resplendent, young, handsome the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana shone unblemished. As they followed sage Viswamitra spreading radiance, they looked like sons of the god of fire, (Skanda and Visakhu) following the incomprehensible Siva.

verses.sloka: कुमारौ चारु वपुषौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ।अनुयातौ श्रिया दीप्तौ शोभयेताम् अनिन्दितौ ॥१-२२-९॥
verses.transliteration: kumārau cāru vapuṣau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ।anuyātau śriyā dīptau śobhayetām aninditau ॥1-22-9॥

translations.english: Then bows in hand, wellattired, their fingers encased in mongrel skin, for protection (against the bowstring) armed with scimitars, resplendent, young, handsome the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana shone unblemished. As they followed sage Viswamitra spreading radiance, they looked like sons of the god of fire, (Skanda and Visakhu) following the incomprehensible Siva.

verses.sloka: स्थाणुम् देवम् इव अचिन्त्यम् कुमारौ इव पावकी ।अध्यर्ध योजनम् गत्वा सरय्वा दक्षिणे तटे ॥१-२२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sthāṇum devam iva acintyam kumārau iva pāvakī ।adhyardha yojanam gatvā sarayvā dakṣiṇe taṭe ॥1-22-10॥

translations.english: Then bows in hand, wellattired, their fingers encased in mongrel skin, for protection (against the bowstring) armed with scimitars, resplendent, young, handsome the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana shone unblemished. As they followed sage Viswamitra spreading radiance, they looked like sons of the god of fire, (Skanda and Visakhu) following the incomprehensible Siva.
translations.hindi: यह विश्वामित्र शरीर धारण किए हुए धर्म हैं। यह बड़े बल- वान्‌ हैं । इनसे बढ़कर वुद्धिमान और तप:परायणए इस संसार में तो दूसरा कोई है. नहीं

verses.sloka: रामा इति मधुराम् वाणीम् विश्वामित्रः अभ्यभाषत ।गृहाण वत्स सलिलम् मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः ॥१-२२-११॥
verses.transliteration: rāmā iti madhurām vāṇīm viśvāmitraḥ abhyabhāṣata ।gṛhāṇa vatsa salilam mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ ॥1-22-11॥

translations.english: After crossing a distance of over half a yojana on the southern bank of Sarayu, Viswamitra addressed Rama sweet in a gentle voice.
translations.hindi: अनेक असों के चलाने की विधियों को जानने बाले. तीनों लोकों में तथा चर-अचर में यह अकेले ही हे । इनके स्वरुप का ज्ञान हूर किसी को नहीं है और न हो सकता है

verses.sloka: मंत्र ग्रामम् गृहाण त्वम् बलाम् अतिबलाम् तथा ।न श्रमो न ज्वरो वा ते न रूपस्य विपर्ययः ॥१-२२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: maṁtra grāmam gṛhāṇa tvam balām atibalām tathā ।na śramo na jvaro vā te na rūpasya viparyayaḥ ॥1-22-12॥

translations.english: "O child, take this water (in your hands), let there be no delay. You will receive from me a collection of mantras and also bala and atibala.

verses.sloka: न च सुप्तम् प्रमत्तम् वा धर्ष इष्यन्ति नैरृताः ।न बाह्वोः सदृशो वीर्ये पृथिव्याम् अस्ति कश्चन ॥१-२२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: na ca suptam pramattam vā dharṣa iṣyanti nairṛtāḥ ।na bāhvoḥ sadṛśo vīrye pṛthivyām asti kaścana ॥1-22-13॥

translations.english: "(If you receive these mantras), you will experience neither fatigue, nor fever nor will there be a change in your appearance. Whether you are asleep or agitated, rakshasas cannot harm you.
translations.hindi: महाभारत मे लिखा है कि अमृत को रक्षा के लिए उसके चारों ओर चक्राकार अभि जला करता है । कृशाश्व प्रजापति के परम धार्मिक पुत्रों ने विश्वामित्र को; जब वे पहले राज्य करते थे, सव अन्न दिए थे

verses.sloka: त्रिषु लोकेषु वा राम न भवेत् सदृशः तव ।बलाम् अतिबलाम् चैव पठतः तात राघव ॥१-२२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vā rāma na bhavet sadṛśaḥ tava ।balām atibalām caiva paṭhataḥ tāta rāghava ॥1-22-14॥

translations.english: O Rama, there is none in this world equal to the might of your hands nor does such a person exist in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धि निश्चये ।न उत्तरे प्रति वक्तव्ये समो लोके तव अनघ ॥१-२२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: na saubhāgye na dākṣiṇye na jñāne buddhi niścaye ।na uttare prati vaktavye samo loke tava anagha ॥1-22-15॥

translations.english: O sinless one, there is none in this world equal to you in good fortune, kindness, wisdom, in taking a decsion or giving a reply.

verses.sloka: एतत् विद्या द्वये लब्धे न भवेत् सदृशः तव ।बला च अतिबला चैव सर्व ज्ञानस्य मातरौ ॥१-२२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: etat vidyā dvaye labdhe na bhavet sadṛśaḥ tava ।balā ca atibalā caiva sarva jñānasya mātarau ॥1-22-16॥

translations.english: With these two kinds of knowledge secured, there will be none equal to you, at present or in fututre. Bala and atibala are mother to all kinds of knowledge .
translations.hindi: दक्ष प्रजापति की दो कन्यां --जया और सुप्रभा-ने सैकड़ों अति चसचमाते हुए अ-स उत्पन्न किए ॥ {४॥ पञ्चाशतं सुताल्सेभे जया नाम परान्पुरा । वधायाहुरसेन्यानाममेयान्‌ कामरूपिणः

verses.sloka: क्षुत् पिपासे न ते राम भविष्येते नरोत्तम ।बलाम् अतिबलाम् चैव पठतः तात राघव ॥१-२२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: kṣut pipāse na te rāma bhaviṣyete narottama ।balām atibalām caiva paṭhataḥ tāta rāghava ॥1-22-17॥

translations.english: O Rama, best among men, scion in the line of Raghu, on your way you will not feel hunger or thirst if you recite bala and atibala.
translations.hindi: घे कृशाश्व के पुत्र प्रजापति की कन्यां के पुत्र हैं। वे एकः रुप के नहीं हैं। बे वड़े वलवान्‌, दीव्रिमान और सबको जीतने मैं समर्थ है.

verses.sloka: गृहाण सर्व लोकस्य गुप्तये रघु नन्दन ।विद्या द्वयम् अधीयाने यशः च अथ भवेत् भुवि ।पितामह सुते हि एते विद्ये तेजः समन्विते ॥१-२२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa sarva lokasya guptaye raghu nandana ।vidyā dvayam adhīyāne yaśaḥ ca atha bhavet bhuvi ।pitāmaha sute hi ete vidye tejaḥ samanvite ॥1-22-18॥

translations.english: O Rama, born in the line Kakutstha and one who is righteous, these two radiant sciences are daughters of the grandsire Brahma. If you pursue these two sciences, you will get unequalled fame. You are a fit person to confer these two sciences.
translations.hindi: इन सव अख्न-शख्रां को विश्वामित्र यथावत्‌ जानते हैं। यही नहीं, बल्कि इनके अतिरिक्त और नए नए अ्-शख् बनाने की सामथ्यं भी इन धर्मात्मा में है

verses.sloka: प्रदातुम् तव काकुत्थ्स सदृअशः त्वम् हि पार्थिव ।कामम् बहुगुणाः सर्वे त्वयि एते न अत्र संशयः ॥१-२२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: pradātum tava kākutthsa sadṛaśaḥ tvam hi pārthiva ।kāmam bahuguṇāḥ sarve tvayi ete na atra saṁśayaḥ ॥1-22-19॥

translations.english: You possess all these qualities in great measure. There is no doubt that If these two sciences (mantras) are nourished with austerities they will assume multiple forms (and benefit you)".

verses.sloka: तपसा संभृते च एते बहु रूपे भविष्यतः ।ततो रामो जलम् स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः ॥१-२२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tapasā saṁbhṛte ca ete bahu rūpe bhaviṣyataḥ ।tato rāmo jalam spṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śuciḥ ॥1-22-20॥

translations.english: Thereafter Rama, touched the water and was sanctified. With a cheerful face he received those two sciences from the maharshi who had perceived the supreme soul.

verses.sloka: प्रति जग्राह ते विद्ये महर्षेर् भावित आत्मनः ।विद्या समुदितो रामः शुशुभे भीम विक्रमः ॥१-२२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: prati jagrāha te vidye maharṣer bhāvita ātmanaḥ ।vidyā samudito rāmaḥ śuśubhe bhīma vikramaḥ ॥1-22-21॥

translations.english: . Rama, the highly heroic after acquiring knowledge (of the two sciences) and having rendered all services to preceptor Viswamitra, appeared resplendent like the Sungod in autumn. There the three of them spent the night comfortably on the bank of Sarayu.
translations.hindi: इन विश्वामित्र जी में इतनी सामर्थ्य है कि, ये उन राक्तसों को स्वयं मार सकते हैं। यह तो आपसे, पुत्र की भलाई के लिए ही, उन्हें माँगने आए हैं

verses.sloka: सहस्र रश्मिः भग्वान् शरदीव दिवाकरः ।गुरु कार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिक आत्मजे ।ऊषुः ताम् रजनीम् तत्र सरय्वाम् सुसुखम् त्रयः ॥१-२२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sahasra raśmiḥ bhagvān śaradīva divākaraḥ ।guru kāryāṇi sarvāṇi niyujya kuśika ātmaje ।ūṣuḥ tām rajanīm tatra sarayvām susukham trayaḥ ॥1-22-22॥

translations.english: . Rama, the highly heroic after acquiring knowledge (of the two sciences) and having rendered all services to preceptor Viswamitra, appeared resplendent like the Sungod in autumn. There the three of them spent the night comfortably on the bank of Sarayu.

verses.sloka: दशरथ नृइप सूनु सत्तमाभ्याम्तृण शयने अनुचिते तदा उषिताभ्याम् ।कुशिक सुत वचोऽनुलालिताभ्याम् ।सुखमिव सा विबभौ विभावरी च ॥१-२२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: daśaratha nṛipa sūnu sattamābhyāmtṛṇa śayane anucite tadā uṣitābhyām ।kuśika suta vaco'nulālitābhyām ।sukhamiva sā vibabhau vibhāvarī ca ॥1-22-23॥

translations.english: The night was spent as though with comfort by the two eminent sons of Dasaratha, who shared the unaccustomed bed of grass. They were kept in good humour by the words of Kusika's son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twenty second sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
